Shun Pao: (Nanking Telegram);

EXPLANATION OF THE REPRESENTATIVES CONFERENCE.

The Central Executive Committee, on April 9,
sent the following circular telegram to the various
Tangpus throughout the whole country:-
"In the telegram sent out by Wang Chao Yi and
Hu Han Lin, there are many mis-statements regarding the
convocation of the all-China Representatives Conference
by the Standing Committee of the Central Kuomintang.
We make the following explanation:-
"According to the General Principles of National
Construction, the People's Conference can only be convoked
when the greater part of the country has completed district
autonomy. But, although district autonomy has been
obstructed by Communism and the Japanese invasion, the
opening of the People's Conference should not be disturbed.
Our Standing Committee has exerted its utmost to introduce
complete district autonomy within two years of the holding
of the People's Conference which is fixed for April, 1935.
It is better for us to convoke an extraordinary meeting
of all-China Representatives on July 1 to decide the
question of the convocation of the People's Conference."

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

THE INCREASE OF HAWKERS LICENSE FEE.

At the request of the 3,000 stall-keepers in
the French Concession, the French Concession Stall Keepers
Association sent a letter on April 5 to the French
Municipal Council requesting it not to increase the
licenses for hawkers.
Yesterday the French Municipal Council replied
rejecting the request.
The Association yesterday sent another letter
to the Council repeating its request.

《申报》：（南京电）；

关于代表会议的解释。

中央执行委员会于4月9日
向全国各党部发出如下通电解：
“在汪朝邑（音译）和胡汉林（音译）发出的电报中，
关于中国国民党常务委员会召开全中国代表会议一事，
有许多不实陈述。
现作如下解释：
“根据《建国大纲》，国民大会只有在
全国大部分地区完成县自治后方可召开。但是，尽管
县自治受到共产主义和日本入侵的阻碍，
国民大会的召开不应受到干扰。
本会常务委员会已竭尽全力，计划在定于1935年4月
召开的国民大会举行前的两年内，推行完全的县自治。
最好于7月1日召开一次全中国代表特别会议，
以决定国民大会召开的问题。”

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

增加小贩执照费。

应法租界3,000名摊贩的要求，法租界摊贩协会
于4月5日向公董局致函，请求其不要增加
小贩执照费用。
昨日，公董局复函拒绝了该请求。
该协会昨日再次致函公董局，重申其请求。

一笔战争保险赔款未付。

国货工厂联合会（地址：广东路文安里173号）在
《晨报》及其他本地报纸的广告栏刊登如下通告：
直華陳記紡織廠的厂房在“一·二八”战争中
被完全摧毁。该厂投保战争险的外商
德昌保險公司，以及当时承保时的德昌保險公司代理人、
前保盛保險公司的谢祥盛（Zia Za Sung，音译），现为
宁波商业银行保险部经理，均拒绝赔付。要么是德昌保險公司
逃避赔付，要么是谢祥盛侵吞了保费。该厂持有的保险单中
注明，已收到英国“H.G. Polan”（音译）确认承保的电报，
且该保单不得撤回。该厂已支付所有保险费。
未曾想，在战事期间工厂被毁后，德昌保險公司和
谢祥盛谎称该厂的保险已撤回。上海特别市政府、
社会局、商会、钱业公会等机构曾致函德昌保險公司和
谢祥盛，劝其维护声誉，但毫无结果。
在中国从事火灾和战争保险业务的外商
总是向公众宣称他们是资本雄厚的大保险公司的代理，
但当提出索赔时，这些商人往往挑剔被保险人的毛病，
试图逃避赔付。例如，迄今为止，外国保险公司
以闸北的房屋未投保战争险为由，拒绝向房主赔付。
直華陳記紡織廠持有战争保险单，然而，
保险公司同样未能赔付。
今后，凡欲向外国保险公司投保者，应稍加谨慎。
此事严重影响了公众对外国保险公司的信心，我们希望
外商保险同业公会能公正解决此案。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

中国计划兴建八大工业工程

实业部长陈公博昨日抵达上海。
本报记者采访陈先生时，他表示部里正安排建立
八大工业工程，如中央造纸厂、中央酒精厂、
中央机器厂、中央钢铁厂等。陈部长补充说，
中央政府正特别关注中俄贸易。

Commercial Bank, who acted as agent of the Tuh Chong
Insurance Company at the time when the policy was taken out,
refused to pay compensation. Either the Tuh Chong Insuranc
Company has evaded payment or Zia Za Sung has embezzled the
money. The Factory holds an insurance policy in which it
is stated that a telegram has been received from "H.G. Polan"
of England confirming the insurance and that the policy can
not be withdrawn. The Factory paid all the insurance
premia. Unexpectedly after the demolition of the Factory
during the hostilities, the Tuh Chong Insurance Company and
Zia Za Sung falsely alleged that the insurance of the
Factory had been withdrawn. Letters were sent by the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, the Social Bureau, the
Chamber of Commerce, the Native Bankers Association and
other bodies to the Tuh Chong Insurance Company and Zin
Za Sung advising them to maintain their reputation, but
without result.
Foreign merchants engaged in fire and war insurance
business in China always tell the public that they are agents
of big insurance companies with large capital, but when
claims are sent in these merchants very often find fault
with the insured in an attempt to evade payment. For
instance, foreign insurance companies have, so far, refused
to pay compensation to the owners of houses in Chapel on
the ground that they were not issued against war risk.
The Chi Hwa Chen Kee Spinning & Weaving Factory held a war
insurance policy, nevertheless, the insurance company has
equally failed to pay.
Henceforth, people who are about to take out
insurance policies with foreign insurance companies should
exercise a little care. This matter is seriously affecting
public confidence in foreign insurance companies and we
hope that the Foreign Insurance Merchants Association will
find a fair settlement of the case in question.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

CHINA PLANNING EIGHT LARGE INDUSTRIAL WORKS

Chen Kung Po, Minister of Industry, arrived in
Shanghai yesterday.
Interviewed by our reporter, Mr. Chen said that
the Ministry is arranging to establish eight large
industrial works, such as a Central Paper Manufacturing
Factory, a Central Alcohol Factory, a Central Engine Works,
a Central Steel & Iron Works, etc. The Minister added that
the Central Government is paying special attention to Sino-
Russian trade.
